SpheroidPy.experiment.analysis module

class SpheroidPy.experiment.analysis.Analysis(name: str, experiment: Experiment)[source]

Bases: Base

Class for orchestrating analyses across multiple experimental results.

Handles biological replicates and coordinates analysis methods implemented in SpheroidImage across multiple Results.

name

Name of the analysis

replicates_dict

Maps condition names to lists of replicate Results

analysis_results

Stores computed metrics and analyses

config

Configuration parameters for analyses

add_replicate(result: Result, name: str | None = None)[source]

Add a Result as a biological replicate.

Parameters:

  • result – Result to add as replicate

  • name – Optional name for the replicate group

Saves replicate information to HDF5 file structure: /Analysis/{index}-{name}/replicates/

├── results/ │ └── {result_name} └── conditions/

└── {condition}/

├── name ├── spheroid_list └── metadata

add_time_period(name: str | None = None, *, relative: tuple[float, float] | None = None, absolute: dict[str, tuple[str | datetime, str | datetime]] | None = None, conditions: list[str] | None = None)[source]

Add a time period for analysis.

Parameters:

  • name – Name for the time period

  • relative – Optional (start_hours, end_hours) from replicate start

  • absolute – Optional dict mapping result_names to (start_date, end_date)

  • conditions – Optional list of conditions to apply to (default: all)

Example

# Add relative time period for all conditions analysis.add_time_period(

“day2”, relative=(24, 48) # 24-48h from each replicate’s start

)

# Add absolute time period for specific conditions analysis.add_time_period(

“phase1”, absolute={

‘Day1_Result’: (‘2024-01-01’, ‘2024-01-02’), ‘Day2_Result’: (‘2024-01-02’, ‘2024-01-03’)

}, conditions=[‘Control’, ‘Treatment’]

)

analyze_functional_radii(live_channel: str | None = None, death_channel: str | None = None) → DataFrame[source]

Analyze functional radii across all replicates.

Computes outer, inhibited and necrotic radii for all spheroids in each replicate group.

Parameters:

  • death_channel – Override default dead cell fluorescence channel

Returns:

DataFrame containing functional radii measurements for all conditions

analysis(name: str | None = None) → Analysis | dict[source]

Get or create an Analysis object.

Parameters:

name – Name of the Analysis to get/create. If None, returns dictionary of all Analyses.

Returns:

If name is None, returns dictionary of all Analyses. If name is provided, returns the specified Analysis object, creating it if it doesn’t exist.

Raises:

Exception – If name is provided but is not a string.

dataclass(*, init=True, repr=True, eq=True, order=False, unsafe_hash=False, frozen=False, match_args=True, kw_only=False, slots=False)

Returns the same class as was passed in, with dunder methods added based on the fields defined in the class.

Examines PEP 526 __annotations__ to determine fields.

If init is true, an __init__() method is added to the class. If repr is true, a __repr__() method is added. If order is true, rich comparison dunder methods are added. If unsafe_hash is true, a __hash__() method function is added. If frozen is true, fields may not be assigned to after instance creation. If match_args is true, the __match_args__ tuple is added. If kw_only is true, then by default all fields are keyword-only. If slots is true, an __slots__ attribute is added.

delete(name: str)[source]

load_images(img_folder_path: Path, brightfield_filters: str | list | None = None, fluorescence_green_filters: str | list | None = None, fluorescence_red_filters: str | list | None = None, fluorescence_blue_filters: str | list | None = None, image_size: tuple | None = None) → DataFrame[source]

Load and process image data from specified folder.

Searches for images matching the specified filters and loads them into SpheroidImage instances organized by well and timepoint.

Parameters:

  • img_folder_path – Path to folder containing image files

  • brightfield_filters – Filter pattern(s) for brightfield images

  • fluorescence_green_filters – Optional filter pattern(s) for green fluorescence

  • fluorescence_red_filters – Optional filter pattern(s) for red fluorescence

  • fluorescence_blue_filters – Optional filter pattern(s) for blue fluorescence

  • image_size – Optional tuple (width, height) specifying image size in μm

Returns:

DataFrame summarizing loaded image data

Raises:

Exception – If data has already been loaded for this Result

metric(name: str = 'radius', mean: bool = False, plot: bool = False, skip_nan: bool = False, interpolate: bool = True, ignore_border: bool = True) → DataFrame | tuple[source]

Calculate specified metric across wells and timepoints.

Computes metrics like radius or area for each well/timepoint and optionally averages across replicates defined in the platemap.

Parameters:

  • name – Metric to calculate (‘radius’, ‘area’, ‘fluorescence_*’)

  • mean – Whether to average across replicate wells

  • plot – Whether to display plot of results

  • skip_nan – Whether to exclude NaN values from plots

  • interpolate – Whether to interpolate missing timepoints

  • ignore_border – Whether to exclude spheroids touching image border

Returns:

DataFrame containing metric values, optionally with mean/std across replicates

Raises:

Exception – If no data has been loaded
